summary: AUTO-INVITE on publish + ESCROW/QR e2e regression — 6/6 tests PASS. Verified: (1) create+publish of a pulizie richiesta auto-populates provider_invitati with compatible providers (auto=True), and req-prov-token (impresa) sees it in /pulizie/incoming WITHOUT any admin invite; propose(accept) transitions to con_proposte. (2) Same for babysitting persona_lf — Giulia (prov-test-token-888) is auto-invited and sees it in /babysitting/incoming. (3) Same for artigiani — an art_listini-seeded provider is auto-invited and sees it in /artigiani/incoming. (4) End-to-end escrow pulizie QR-off (confirm blocks, complete releases immediately to business earner) still green. (5) Pulizie QR-on: complete ARMS (conferma_pending=true, escrow.stato=held), delivery_confirmations doc exists, GET /delivery/ref/{rid} returns code, wrong code→400, non-earner→403, correct code→released + immediate credit. (6) Driver auto-confirm branch (direct target + listino accept) now correctly holds escrow and releases on complete → Giulia's pending_balance +net, wallet_holds pending doc created (prior iter46 CRITICAL bug FIXED). Client wallet + qr pref restored to seed (500 + 50 bonus, qr OFF) after run.
action_items: No fixes required — all originally reported issues (auto-matching gap on publish + QR/escrow linkage) verified as resolved end-to-end. Main agent can close this thread.

Notifications pushed to every auto-invited provider. Admin invite (POST /admin/pulizie/richieste/{rid}/invite) remains available for reassignment / re-inviting declined providers — correctly idempotent.
routers/babysitting.py:362-371 — same pattern for babysitting. Persona_lf INPS gate is enforced inside compatible_providers so unregistered LF providers are correctly skipped.
routers/artigiani.py:250-256 — same pattern. Compatibility uses art_listini[mestiere] + binario + urgenze + raggio_km. Provider notifications fire.

routers/driver.py:303-330 — already had auto-invite (unchanged, working). The iter46 auto-confirm escrow bug (missing we.hold in propose+accept when direct target) has been fixed by main agent — verified: escrow.stato='held' immediately, prezzo debited from client wallet, and on /complete → provider pending_balance += net + wallet_holds doc created.
wallet_escrow.py + confirm_delivery.py unchanged from iter46 review — QR arm/release logic, refund idempotency, and bonus-first _deduct all verified end-to-end here.

Client wallet reset to 500 + 50 bonus and qr_confirm_enabled=false after every test and once more after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-invite is now the primary matching path (admin invite endpoints remain as fallback / re-invite). If future changes touch compatible_providers(...) in any of the 4 category routers, rerun `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auto_invite_iter47.py -v` — first three tests will catch a broken match filter and the last three catch escrow regressions. Test preserves client wallet (500 + 50) and qr_confirm_enabled=false. Uses tokens: disp-test-token-777 (client), req-prov-token (impresa business, immediate credit path), prov-test-token-888 (Giulia — provider pending_balance path + babysitter persona_lf + driver ncc), and any DB-discovered artigiano provider with art_listini.
rca_of_issue: The originally reported bugs are RESOLVED and verified end-to-end: (1) auto-matching gap (issue #2) — root cause was create endpoints leaving provider_invitati empty until an admin manually invited providers; fix populates provider_invitati at publish time by calling compatible_providers() for pulizie/babysitting/artigiani (driver already did). This test proves the wire is intact from client publish → provider /incoming without any admin step, for all three categories. (2) QR/escrow linkage (issue #1) — verified the full chain client owner GET /delivery/ref/{rid} → earner POST /delivery/confirm-code → escrow release + earner credit + delivery_confirmations.released=true. Wrong code returns 400 invalid_code; a different (non-earner) authenticated user returns 403 (guard checks confirm['earner_id']==caller). No regressions detected.
